Name: dragonfire
Blurb: A forward cone of violet fire that leaves Fracture Burn.
Upgrades: Eruption at the end of the breath

Name: wyrmwing
Blurb: Spectral wings: a launch, a controlled glide and one air dash.

Name: dragonhide
Blurb: Spectral scales: damage resistance and less stagger. Time it for a bonus.
Upgrades: Shares a smaller shield with nearby allies

Name: wyrmcall
Blurb: Vyrak answers: strafing runs, dragonfire on a group, interrupts, a finishing assault.

Name: roar
Blurb: Vyrak bellows: nearby enemies are staggered and their next attack is delayed. Bosses only lose poise.
Upgrades: Enemies take extra damage while staggered

Name: scalebreaker
Blurb: A tail-and-claw slam in front of you that shatters armor and hits boss poise hard.

Name: skyfall
Blurb: Vyrak climbs, then dives onto the target area in a violet impact. Needs room above and is a late-game finisher.
